_doc: Canonical closed vocabulary for harness RSI-lifecycle relations (decisions/, improvement-log, predictions, trailers). Single source of truth; all enforcers LOAD this, never re-state it. Authored from a git-grep probe of decisions/ 2026-06-18. Conventions: (1) a canonical entry with traversable:false (only relates_to) is a non-lifecycle association edge — kept for authoring + drift coverage but EXCLUDED from neighborhood traversal; absent traversable defaults true. (2) a fold entry with invert:true is the INVERSE of its canonical target — consumers MUST swap subject/target when normalizing (A superseded_by B => B supersedes A), never relabel in place.

branches_from.doc: A diverges from B; B still stands

retires.doc: A marks B obsolete with no replacement

cross_repo_of.doc: A is the cross-repo twin of B

relates_to.doc: generic association (catch-all); NOT a lifecycle edge

superseded_by.note: inverse direction — subject/target swap on migration

applies_lesson_from.note: A builds on a lesson from B = constraint/dependency, not generic

respects_vetoes_of.note: A constrained by B's vetoes = dependency
